Employment

1.Faculty of University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Eshelman School of Pharmacy, Chemical Biology and Medicinal Chemistry Division Assistant Professor (1970-1974), Associate Professor (1974-1977), Professor (1977-1991), Chairman (1998-1999), Kenan Distinguished Professor (1992－), Director of Natural Products Research Laboratories (1983－)

2.Honorary Professor, Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences (1996)

3.Honorary Professor, Institute of Medicinal Plant Development, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences (1999)

4.Chair Professor and Honorary Director, Chinese Medicine Research and Development Center, China Medical University and Hospital, Taiwan (2010－)

5.Chair Professor, College of Pharmacy, Kaohsiung Medical University, Taiwan (2011－)

6.Chairman, Committee for the Promotion of Chinese Herbal Medicine Industry and Technology, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (2000-2005)

7.Member of Advisory Board for numerous institutions in Taiwan, Hong Kong & U.S.A.

Editorial Advisory Board of 25 scientific journals
